name: sticky
description: A board fixed beside the conversation: what Claude needs from you, what is in progress, and what you should not miss.

notify.title: Notify me of a new ask while I am away
notify.description: Raises a notification when Claude pins an ask and you have not typed or pressed anything for two minutes.

showKeys.title: Show the board's keys
showKeys.description: Puts a keys entry in the board's last row: press k there to list the keys that work on the board.
